transcript.text: I was reminiscing about that trip where I went from Beijing to Shanghai—still can’t believe how packed the station was.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And then later that month I also ended up in Hangzhou for a bit—pretty sure I overdid it on the lake photos.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: After that I swung through Chengdu too, mostly just to eat my way around the city with friends.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Back in Beijing, I remember we were chatting about what movies were out around then—felt like everyone had an opinion.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the Beijing–Shanghai leg, my friend had already booked me on train G1, and it was under my name, Li Na.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That ticket was for 2025-03-22, and I rode in Second Class—honestly totally fine for the ride.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Hangzhou, Liu Yang had already arranged the stay at Hilton Hangzhou West Lake, checking in on 2025-03-12.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We stayed 4 nights, and in Chengdu we did that huge hotpot dinner at Lao Ma Tou Hotpot on 2025-03-19 at 19:00—party size was 9.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Wang Fang was the contact for that dinner and used 13836661033, and later in Beijing I’d already bought 2 tickets for "Article 20" at CGV Xidan for the 15:30 showtime—also under Li Na.
